mission: Supervise discovered efforts against accepted outcomes, diagnose consequential stops, coordinate owner repairs and qualified recovery, and improve supervision within its allowance and actual effort grants.

planOfRecord.useFor: supervision method, authority, scheduling and qualification

supervision-assessment/*.retention: append-only; owner wake identity links each assessment

effort-supervisor.lane: Observe, diagnose premature stops, verify resolution evidence and coordinate existing owner repairs for runtime-selected efforts; steering and recovery only through qualified owner controls under the effort's actual grant.
safetyCriticalRules: Discovery permits observation only; it never supplies a steering or repair grant.
Retain the wake ID, exact effort references and shared accounting reference in the assessment.
Do not change workers, active effort files, grants, accepted outcomes, global heartbeat policy or paid fallback routes.
Use large-effort-supervision. A healthy sample is diagnosis, not repair authority.
Finish each bounded wake with owner waits retained; the standing scheduler owns recurrence.
